title: Wonderful Peru
short_description: Discover Lima, Paracas, Ica, Huacachina, Cusco, the Sacred Valley, Machu Picchu, Humantay Lake and Rainbow Mountain in 8 days.
long_description:
Enjoy an unforgettable 8-day, 7-night journey through Peru.

Begin in Lima and continue through Paracas, the Ballestas Islands, Ica and Huacachina. Then travel to the Andes for Cusco, the Sacred Valley, Machu Picchu, Humantay Lake and Rainbow Mountain.
price_note: From USD 559 per person. Subject to availability.

days.title: Day 1: Arrival in Lima
days.text: Airport reception and transfer. Free time to explore Miraflores, its boardwalk and Pacific views.

days.title: Day 2: Paracas – Ica – Huacachina
days.text: Boat tour of the Ballestas Islands, Ica wine tasting and lunch, and a Huacachina adventure with dune buggies and sandboarding. Return to Lima.

days.title: Day 3: Lima – Cusco
days.text: Travel to Cusco, airport reception and transfer. Free day to acclimatize at approximately 3,400 m.

days.title: Day 4: Sacred Valley
days.text: Visit Chinchero, Moray, Maras Salt Mines, Urubamba, Ollantaytambo and Pisac, with buffet lunch.

days.title: Day 5: Machu Picchu
days.text: Train to Aguas Calientes, bus and guided visit to Machu Picchu on the assigned circuit. Return to Cusco.

days.title: Day 6: Humantay Lake
days.text: Breakfast and a 1.5 to 2-hour hike to Humantay Lake, guided visit, lunch and return to Cusco.

days.title: Day 7: Rainbow Mountain
days.text: Breakfast in Cusipata and a 1.5 to 2-hour hike to Vinicunca. Lunch and return to Cusco.

days.title: Day 8: Farewell
days.text: Free time according to your flight and coordinated transfer to Cusco Airport.
